root_cause.text: When processing an undefined radiotap field (e.g., field 18) in the radiotap namespace, the parser attempts to use the uninitialized `iterator->_next_ns_data` variable to skip remaining data because the early rejection for unknown radiotap namespace bits was placed before the alignment check, leaving `_next_ns_data` uninitialized (it is only set for vendor namespace skipping).
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "if the undefined field 18 is used, the alignment/size is unknown as well. In this case, iterator->_next_ns_data isn't initialized (it's only set for skipping vendor namespaces)". The patch moves the `if (iterator->current_namespace == &radiotap_ns) return -ENOENT;` check inside the `if (!align)` block, before the use of `_next_ns_data`, thus preventing the uninitialized access.
